metaDescription: Help expand ForThePeople.in to your district: report errors, suggest data sources, request your district or contribute code.
title: Contribute
description: ForThePeople.in is built and maintained by volunteers. Every contribution, big or small, helps more citizens access the data they're entitled to.
simple: There are {n} ways to help below. Most of them take less than five minutes.
thanks: Thank you! Your submission has been received. We'll review it shortly.
way_report_desc: Found incorrect or outdated data? Tell us. We correct errors within 24 hours.
way_request_desc: Your district isn't listed yet? Submit a request and we'll prioritise it based on demand.
way_code_desc: The platform is open source. Pull requests are welcome, from bug fixes to new data modules.
way_translate_desc: We need native speakers to check regional-language labels. All Indian languages are welcome.
way_source_desc: Know of a government portal or dataset we haven't used yet? Let us know.
way_share_desc: Share ForThePeople.in with journalists, researchers, students and local officials in your district.
openBody: ForThePeople.in is fully open source under the MIT licence. The code, data pipelines and seed data are all publicly available. We believe transparency about our own platform is as important as the data transparency we provide.
reqUnits: Votes from citizens for districts that are not live yet
reqSimple: {name} is asked for most so far, with {n, plural, one {# vote} other {# votes}}.
sheetSub: We read every message. Leave an email if you would like a reply.
namePlaceholder: So we know who to thank
hintNoEmail: Without an email we can't reply, but we still read every message.
errorFailed: Could not send. Please try again.
